content_units: Osaka 4-Day Weather Snapshot
Current live weather is not included in your data, so this summary is based on the provided forecast for   Osaka, Japan (JST)   from   2025-10-18 to 2025-10-21  .
- Your top priorities are   low rain chance   and   comfortable walking weather  .
- Based on that,   2025-10-20 (Monday)   is the strongest full-day outdoor pick for   Osaka Castle  .
Osaka Castle Visit Comparison
Day   Condition   Temp   Rain Chance   Wind   What it means for walking
Sat, Oct 18   Light rain   19–24°C   70%   18 kph   Least suitable; likely interruptions and damp grounds
Sun, Oct 19   Cloudy   17–23°C   20%   12 kph   Good backup day; cooler and fairly comfortable
Mon, Oct 20   Sunny   16–26°C   5%   9 kph   Best overall; driest day with light wind
Tue, Oct 21   Partly cloudy   18–25°C   10%   14 kph   Very good option; slightly breezier than Oct 20
Best Day for Osaka Castle
Best choice: Monday, 2025-10-20
-   Lowest rain chance:     5%
-   Comfortable walking range:     16–26°C
-   Lightest wind:     9 kph
-   Sunny conditions   make it best for castle grounds, moat-area walks, and photos
Runner-up:     Tuesday, 2025-10-21
- Also very solid for a full day outdoors
- Slightly higher rain chance and more wind than Oct 20, but still very comfortable
Quick Visit Tips for Osaka Castle
- Go   morning to mid-afternoon   on   Oct 20   for the most pleasant walking conditions.
- Bring   light layers  : the morning may feel cool, but midday should be warm.
- If plans change,   Oct 21   is the next-best alternative.
